text:
Guillaume Brisebois has been filling a hole on Vancouver's blue line. The 29-year-old, a 2015 third-round pick of the Canucks, has played six games this season, four of them in the last week and a half, and his minutes have grown to 17 to 19 a night in the last three.

Six games is too few to say much. He picked up his first assist on Nov 7 in Edmonton, finishing a cross-ice pass that Pass it to Bulis's Daniel Wagner credited to Linus Karlsson's work. The rest is rough: the Canucks have lost all six games he has played, and at five on five they have had 28.8% of the expected goals with him on the ice. He is a depth defenseman being asked to play second-pair minutes on a team that is struggling. Our range for his scoring is wide, which is what small samples do. Watch whether those minutes hold.
headline: Guillaume Brisebois is back in Vancouver's lineup
